NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 10 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 13, 10:49 AM ET

The Rams are the top-projected defense on the Week 10 DraftKings main slate at 8.6 DraftKings points for $3,800, at Arizona. Jaguars (7.6, $4,000) and Seahawks (7.5, $3,300) are next.

The Seahawks return the most per dollar among defenses projected for at least 6 points: 2.27 projected points per $1,000 at $3,300.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 13, 10:49 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 10

Rams, LAR at ARI ($3,800)

Rams carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 8.6 DraftKings points at $3,800. That is 1.0 points clear of Jaguars. The salary works out to 2.26 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 7 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Rams averaged 8.7 points with a simulated floor of -0.2 and a ceiling of 15.3, and it holds 3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 9.5-point favorite on the road against Arizona, with an implied team total of 24.5 in a game totaled at 39.5.

Value: Seahawks, SEA at LV ($3,300)

Seahawks projects for 7.5 DraftKings points at $3,300, which works out to 2.27 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 7 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 10,000 simulations Seahawks averaged 7.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 16.4, and it holds 5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Seattle is a 6.5-point favorite on the road against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 40.5.
